routes.label: Evaluate the product and compare nearby choices

question: The product \((1.8)(40.3 + 0.07)\) is closest to
solution:
Evaluate the parentheses first, then multiply:
\[
1.8(40.3+0.07)=1.8(40.37)=72.666.
\]
The choices immediately below and above this value are \(42\) and \(74\), so only these can be closest. Their distances from the product are
\[
72.666-42=30.666,
\qquad
74-72.666=1.334.
\]
Therefore the product is closest to \(\boxed{74}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
